description: This file contains utility functions for parsing, classifying, and generating configurations for running tests with Vitest, focusing on handling test project arguments, build plans, and related operations within a testing setup.

methods.name: normalizePathPattern
methods.description: Replaces backslashes in a path pattern with forward slashes for normalization.

methods.name: isExistingPathTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists relative to the current working directory.

methods.name: isExistingFileTarget
methods.description: Checks if a given path points to an existing file.

methods.name: isGlobTarget
methods.description: Determines if a string contains glob pattern characters.

methods.name: isFileLikeTarget
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a test file pattern (e.g., *.test.ts).

methods.name: isPathLikeTargetArg
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a path, glob pattern, or test file pattern.

methods.name: toRepoRelativeTarget
methods.description: Converts a path or pattern into a repository-relative normalized path.

methods.name: toScopedIncludePattern
methods.description: Creates an include pattern for test files based on a path argument.

methods.name: classifyTarget
methods.description: Classifies a given target argument into categories like 'e2e', 'extension', 'channel', etc.

methods.name: createVitestArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for running Vitest based on given parameters.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine forwarded args, target test files, and watch mode.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Builds execution plans for Vitest runs based on target classification and arguments.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Generates detailed run specifications for each plan, including environment setup.

methods.name: writeVitestIncludeFile
methods.description: Outputs the include patterns to a JSON file for Vitest to use.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Creates the final list of command-line arguments for executing Vitest based on input args.
